The '''DL87 armor enhancement''', also known as the '''"frostback"''', was a model of [[Heating system/Legends|heating system]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Built by [[Atlas Corp]] it sold for 1000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and kept its wearer protected from low temperatures using insulation and heating elements. It could be installed into any suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that covered the entire body and was sealable.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The DL87 armor enhancement was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]]. The same information was also included in the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released the [[2014|following year]] by Fantasy Flight Games.
